snippet.title: Warhammer: Dark Omen | Trailer [GOG]
snippet.description:

Facebook: 👉  https://bit.ly/2NWKVCw

In a war-torn world, mighty armies clash to decide the fate of imperiled realms. Brave warriors march forward accompanied by fearless heroes, terrifying monsters and devastating machines of war. Swarms of arrows darken the sky, swords clash against shields, and bloody banners are held aloft in victory, amongst the carnage of the battlefield.

Enter the world of Warhammer and experience iconic real-time strategic combat. Dark Omen casts you in the role of Commander Morgan Bernhardt, leader of the Grudgebringer mercenary army. Command regiments of cavalry, infantry and archers as well as wizards, war machines and monsters in an epic struggle to wipe the hordes of darkness from the face of the Old World™.
